title: bug: CoxPH coefficients aren't invariant to uniform weight scaling
description:
Cox regression coefficients should be invariant to uniform weight scaling (multiplying all weights by a constant). When all weights are scaled uniformly, only the log-likelihood should scale proportionally. Really the coefficients should remain unchanged. What I found though is that Greenwood's CoxPH produces different coefficients when weights are uniformly scaled.

This is a big problem because it'll yield unexpected results when using observational weights (ones that differ by small amount). Statistical theory says that coefficients should be scale-invariant, and they're not.
